description: The inspector is pinned to the current Capsule 0.2 contract and official local SQLite WASM engine.
sql_text: SELECT id FROM inspector_reference WHERE supported_format <> 'org.sqlite-capsule/0.2' OR engine_package <> '@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm' OR engine_version <> '3.53.0-build1'

description: The target boundary stays local, read-only, and catalogue-only.
sql_text: SELECT id FROM inspector_reference WHERE execution_policy <> 'catalogue-only' OR target_write_policy <> 'never' OR network_policy <> 'none' OR max_file_bytes <> 67108864
